chapterInfo.content:
10
1Me nkwa yɛ me kra nwunu,
mɛgyaa m’apinisie mu wɔ me mu,
mɛkasa m’awerɛhoɔ mu.
2Mɛse Onyankopɔn sɛ: Mmu me fɔ,
ma menhunu adekodeɛ a enti wo ne me ham yi.
3Ɛyɛ ma wo sɛ wohyɛ obi soɔ anaa,
sɛ wopo wo nsa ano adwuma
na wopene abɔnefoɔ agyina soɔ?
4 # 1 Sa 16.7 Wowɔ honam aniwa
anaasɛ wohunu adeɛ sɛ ɔdasani hu no?
5Wo nna te sɛ ɔdasani nna
anaa wo mfeɛ te sɛ onipa nna anaa?
6Sɛ wohwehwɛ me mfomsoɔ akyiri kwan
na wodi me bɔne akyire?
7Nanso wonim sɛ menyɛ ɔbɔnefoɔ,
na obi nni hɔ a ɔbɛgye wo nsam.
8 # Dwom 139.14 Wo nsa na ɛnwonoo me na ɛyɛɛ me,
me nipa mu nyinaa prɛko, ɛnna woamene me yi.
9 # Hiob 33.6; Gye 2.7; 3.19 Kae sɛ wonwonoo me sɛ anwommoɔ,
na wobɛma madane mfuturo bio anaa?
10Anaa woanhwie me angu sɛ nufosuo na womaa mepii sɛ nufosuo a akyenkyen ɛtoa?
11Wode wedeɛ ne nam na ɛhyɛɛ me,
na wode nnompe ne ntini wurawuraa me mu.
12Nkwa ne adɔeɛ na wode ayɛ me,
na wo hwɛ nso wɛn me honhom.
13Na yeinom na wode siee w’akomam;
na mahunu sɛ yei na wowɔ tia me.
14Sɛ meyɛ bɔne a, wobɛhwɛ me,
na woremmu me bem me mfomsoɔ ho.
15Sɛ medi abɔnefosɛm a, mennue,
na sɛ metene nso a, meremma me tiri so;
ɛfiri sɛ ahohora ahyɛ me ma,
na mehwɛ m’amanehunu.
16 # Yes 38.13 Na sɛ mema me ho so a, wobɛti me sɛ gyata
na woasane ne me adi anwanwasɛm.
17Na wode w’adansefoɔ afoforɔ ara abɛgyina m’anim,
na woama w’abufuo adɔɔso me so,
na ɛdɔm a ɛto dɔm agu me so.
18 # Hiob 3.3, 11; Yer 20.14 Adɛn nti na woyii me firii yafunu mu?
Anka menya megyaa mu na ani biara anhu me ɛ!
19Sɛ menya meyɛɛ sɛ adeɛ a ɛnni hɔ ɛ!
Mefirii yafunu mu no, ɛnna anka wɔkɔgyaa me ɛda mu ɛ!
20Me nna nyɛ kakraa bi?
Ma no nnyaa me, ɔnyi n’ani mfiri me so, na me ho nsane me kakra,
21 # Hiob 7.10 ansa na makɔ deɛ merensane memma,
na makɔ sum ne sunsum asase so,
22esum kabii a ɛte sɛ ɔdasuom tumm asase,
sunsum ne sakasaka asase a hann te sɛ ɔdasuom tumm no.

pageProps.chapterText:
Me nkwa yɛ me kra nwunu,
mɛgyaa m’apinisie mu wɔ me mu,
mɛkasa m’awerɛhoɔ mu.
Mɛse Onyankopɔn sɛ: Mmu me fɔ,
ma menhunu adekodeɛ a enti wo ne me ham yi.
Ɛyɛ ma wo sɛ wohyɛ obi soɔ anaa,
sɛ wopo wo nsa ano adwuma
na wopene abɔnefoɔ agyina soɔ?
Wowɔ honam aniwa
anaasɛ wohunu adeɛ sɛ ɔdasani hu no?
Wo nna te sɛ ɔdasani nna
anaa wo mfeɛ te sɛ onipa nna anaa?
Sɛ wohwehwɛ me mfomsoɔ akyiri kwan
na wodi me bɔne akyire?
Nanso wonim sɛ menyɛ ɔbɔnefoɔ,
na obi nni hɔ a ɔbɛgye wo nsam.
Wo nsa na ɛnwonoo me na ɛyɛɛ me,
me nipa mu nyinaa prɛko, ɛnna woamene me yi.
Kae sɛ wonwonoo me sɛ anwommoɔ,
na wobɛma madane mfuturo bio anaa?
Anaa woanhwie me angu sɛ nufosuo na womaa mepii sɛ nufosuo a akyenkyen ɛtoa?
Wode wedeɛ ne nam na ɛhyɛɛ me,
na wode nnompe ne ntini wurawuraa me mu.
Nkwa ne adɔeɛ na wode ayɛ me,
na wo hwɛ nso wɛn me honhom.
Na yeinom na wode siee w’akomam;
na mahunu sɛ yei na wowɔ tia me.
Sɛ meyɛ bɔne a, wobɛhwɛ me,
na woremmu me bem me mfomsoɔ ho.
Sɛ medi abɔnefosɛm a, mennue,
na sɛ metene nso a, meremma me tiri so;
ɛfiri sɛ ahohora ahyɛ me ma,
na mehwɛ m’amanehunu.
Na sɛ mema me ho so a, wobɛti me sɛ gyata
na woasane ne me adi anwanwasɛm.
Na wode w’adansefoɔ afoforɔ ara abɛgyina m’anim,
na woama w’abufuo adɔɔso me so,
na ɛdɔm a ɛto dɔm agu me so.

Adɛn nti na woyii me firii yafunu mu?
Anka menya megyaa mu na ani biara anhu me ɛ!
Sɛ menya meyɛɛ sɛ adeɛ a ɛnni hɔ ɛ!
Mefirii yafunu mu no, ɛnna anka wɔkɔgyaa me ɛda mu ɛ!
Me nna nyɛ kakraa bi?
Ma no nnyaa me, ɔnyi n’ani mfiri me so, na me ho nsane me kakra,
ansa na makɔ deɛ merensane memma,
na makɔ sum ne sunsum asase so,
esum kabii a ɛte sɛ ɔdasuom tumm asase,
sunsum ne sakasaka asase a hann te sɛ ɔdasuom tumm no.

app.t1_copy: I've bookmarked passages that are important to me. I've even read the whole thing through in a year thanks to the reading plans.
app.t2_copy: I love how you are able to connect with friends and the Bible reading plans are awesome. This application helps me also to stay consistent in reading because it has reminders for the plans. It also gives me another way to come closer to God. Download this and read every day!
app.t3_copy: Great app with a wide selection of Bibles to choose from. ... The audio Bibles are also wonderful and easy to understand.
app.t4_copy: Many translations and languages available, and many that can be downloaded to read offline. Many useful features, such as the ability to make notes and bookmarks.
app.t5_copy: I love how it has a lot of versions and that there are verses of the day, devotions, plans and community. Thanks for this free app. :)
app.t6_copy: Great because there are many different versions and I could download multiple versions for offline reading. I'm able to listen to this app.
app.t7_copy: Helps me to read the bible more. Love the search and share features and the variety of ways to share. Also like the audio versions.
app.t8_copy: This is a great tool for studying from multiple translations. It's also convenient for listening to the bible when you're driving.
app.t9_copy: This is the best bible app out there. It has the word in different languages and versions for online and offline use. It has devotionals for everything you could think of. You can connect with others and ultimately learn about God and his Word.
